figures.caption: FIG. 1. Phase diagram of cohesive mixing/segregation in a binary system. Comparing the three Bogij (1-1, 2-2, 1-2) for varying size ratios and wetting angles (for identical densities) yields a phase diagram of the asymptotic segregation behavior of wet granular materials. Contrary to previous ﬁndings, we predict that there are particulate systems whereby segregation may be enhanced by cohesion. The solid lines represent the phase boundary between regions where interstitial moisture mitigates segregation (M phase, dark) and where it enhances segregation (E phase, light). The labeled points correspond to experiments in Figs. 2 and 3.
